S. 4949 WOULD MOVE IT TO 2029 · ON THE SENATE CALENDAR SINCE JULY 15, 2026 · AS OF NOV. 12, 2026
texto_aprovado: That leaves the clock. The temporary deal can cover up to three flood seasons, and the spring of 2027 is the third. The law that authorizes the payment expires at the end of August 2027, unless Congress extends it. As of November 2026, a Senate bill would move that date to 2029. The treaty itself remains in force, on-call promise, missing number and all.
